A.title: Trainer levels
A.summary: Trainer level is your account progression, up to level {{maxLevel}}. The XP needed to advance grows by a fixed amount at each level.
points: Every trainer begins at level {{startingLevel}} with {{startingXp}} XP (from the server).
The XP needed to advance increases by {{increment}} at every level, as published by the server.
XP is awarded only by trusted game systems on the server.
Trainer XP and creature XP are separate systems.

B.title: Creature selection
B.summary: Selecting a creature adds a species from the catalog to your collection. How many you can select depends on your trainer level and on the creature's evolution stage.
points: {{starterCount}} starter creatures are offered at onboarding.
Allowances are counted by a creature's original evolution stage at selection time, not its current stage.

C.title: Battle eligibility
C.summary: Battle modes open at different trainer levels.

D.title: Battle XP rewards
D.summary: Trainer XP awarded for each battle result, as published by the server.

E.title: Evolution and trainer level
E.summary: Three different numbers exist in Battle Arena and they are never mixed up.
points: Trainer level is your account progression. It decides how many creatures you can select and which battle modes you can enter.
Evolution stage is a property of a catalog creature (stage 1, 2 or 3). It never changes your trainer level.
Owned creature level belongs to one creature in your collection and progresses independently of your trainer level.
Evolution execution is not available until the server enables it.

F.title: Development status
F.summary: Battle Arena is an evolving technical portfolio project. Feature availability comes from the live API rules endpoint.
points: Rules version and feature availability are loaded from the server.
Browse the public creature catalog for the shared species reference data.
